bullets.text: New CrashFix Variant Detected - **Microsoft Defender** identifies a new tactic in the ClickFix campaign, escalating user disruption.
Operation Winter SHIELD Launched - A nine-week initiative by the **FBI** to bridge the security implementation gap in organizations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New build 28020.1546 offers improvements and fixes for **Windows Insiders**.
WinGet Configuration Simplifies Setup - **WinGet** allows developers to configure their environments with a single command.
Updates in Security Leadership - **Microsoft** announces new leadership roles to enhance focus on security and quality.
Detecting Backdoored Language Models - **Microsoft** releases research on identifying backdoors in language models at scale.
Infostealers Targeting macOS - **Microsoft Defender** reports on the rise of infostealers exploiting macOS and Python.
Securing AI Application Supply Chains - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of securing AI frameworks and SDKs.
